ic_name: JESD204 Serial Interface for Data Converters (JESD204B/C)

lane_waveform.signaling: differential CML NRZ, AC-coupled, per lane.
lane_waveform.clocking: embedded clock recovered by the lane CDR; not source-synchronous.

cgs_waveform.description: RX asserts SYNC~ (low); TX transmits continuous /K28.5/ commas; RX achieves character alignment; SYNC~ de-asserts.

ilas_waveform.starts_on: multiframe / LMFC boundary after SYNC~ de-asserts

data_waveform.framing: S samples/converter/frame; F octets/frame; K frames/multiframe across L lanes.
data_waveform.alignment_chars: /A/(K28.3) at multiframe boundary, /F/(K28.7) at frame boundary (204B).

sysref_waveform.purpose: align the LMFC at TX and RX for deterministic latency.

general_timing_rule: The lane unit interval is set by the lane bit rate (e.g. 80 ps UI at 12.5 Gbps for 204B, 31.25 ps UI at 32 Gbps for 204C). The frame clock and LMFC (period F*K frame clocks) are derived from the shared Device Clock; SYSREF/SYNC~ fix the LMFC phase. ILAS begins on an LMFC boundary so the converter-to-logic latency is deterministic and repeatable.
